messages:
sam_r: Quick sync: CloudBridge + Marketplace are confirmed for the joint webinar on Aug 18. Need run-of-show, demo fallback, speaker bios, and international swag routing.

elaine_m: Great. Can we schedule a full tech rehearsal with speakers on Aug 11? afternoons (EDT) preferred.

drew_t: Aug 11 1pm EDT works for me. I'll handle slide handoff and screen-share checks.

kevin_h: For the live demo, we'll provision via the Marketplace tile then run a short inference call. Suggest pre-recorded 2m clip stored as backup.

rachel_p: I'll own swag: 180 sticker packs, 100 power banks, 40 demo dongle kits. Ship to partner HQ and three speaker addresses. Intl via DHL express.

ops-bot: Reminder: create #eng-oncall channel for webinar day and tag oncall.

elaine_m: Draft 30m run-of-show: host intro (3m) -> partner opener (6m) -> live demo (12m) -> Q&A (7m) -> close (2m). Thoughts?

sam_r: Sounds good. Kevin, can you upload prebaked clip to s3://events/partners/cloudbridge/aug18/backup.mp4 and label v1?

kevin_h: Will do. Also requesting a 1-GPU sandbox on Dedicated for rehearsal (tag partner-rehearsal-aug11).

rachel_p: Shipping timeline: domestic by Aug 9, intl by Aug 6 to allow customs. I'll upload labels to the shared drive.

drew_t: Partner asks for logos + headshots by Jul 28. Can marketing confirm?

sam_r: I'll ping brand ops today. Action items: Elaine schedule dry run Aug 11; Kevin reserve sandbox + upload prebake by Aug 4; Rachel finalize swag shipping and labels by Aug 6; Drew collect slides and get logos by Jul 28; Sam create runbook and #eng-oncall.

sam_r: Locking plan EOD unless objections. :thumbsup:
